item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow night. It will be rather cool and windy in the region over the weekend and early next week. The weather will remain fine over the region next week and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 24/02 (Friday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, north force 5 at night.
Weather: Fine. Warm and dry during the day with some haze.
Temp range: 17 - 26 C
R.H. range: 40 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 25/02 (Saturday)
